article.title: Dolphin AI Film Studio開放早期接入，先支援微短劇製作
article.title_en: Dolphin AI Film Studio opens early access, starting with micro-dramas
article.summary: EloElo Group在印度IFFI宣布Dolphin AI Film Studio，先以微短劇串連腳本、分鏡及影片製作。
article.summary_en: EloElo Group announced Dolphin AI Film Studio at India's IFFI, initially supporting micro-drama production.
highlights: World Lock旨在維持角色、場景及道具的跨鏡頭連續性，並容許局部重新生成。
目前需候補名單或邀請碼；廣告片及品牌內容格式仍在後續計劃。
highlights_en: World Lock is designed to preserve characters, locations and props across shots while allowing selective regeneration.
Access requires a waitlist or invite code; advertising and branded-content formats remain planned.
article.why: 連續敘事的創意團隊可先檢查局部修改能否維持前後鏡頭一致，再決定這種製作流程是否適合系列內容。
article.why_en: Creative teams can test whether selective edits preserve shot continuity before considering the workflow for a content series.
article.next_step: 取得早期資格後，以同一角色及道具規劃三個相連鏡頭，修改其中一個元素，逐格記錄前後一致性。
article.next_step_en: After obtaining access, plan three connected shots with one character and prop, change one element and inspect continuity frame by frame.
article.detail: 消息按公司公告轉載整理，尚無獨立製作成效驗證。平台聲稱可預先顯示生成成本，完成場景後可組合、下載及繼續剪輯。創意團隊可先把人物外觀、道具位置及場景設定寫成鏡頭檢查表，再比較局部重做所需的修訂。這次首先支援微短劇，不能把後續廣告格式的規劃寫成已全面可用。
article.detail_en: This report follows a reproduced company announcement rather than an independent production test. The platform describes upfront generation-cost visibility and scene assembly, downloads and editing. Define character, prop and setting requirements before inspecting selective revisions. Micro-dramas are supported first; planned advertising formats are not generally available.
